reference_policy: reference/before.png = native input before editing; reference/target.png = native target; reference/reference-0.* = public target/context. Compare all against candidate. No whole-image pixel-equality requirement.
focus: Restore the missing bathtub as a curved hollow shell, not a solid rounded block; Demonstrate the recessed bathing cavity and continuous rounded rim; Show visible shell wall thickness and coherent smooth curved ends; Fit the shell onto the existing metal feet at the intended floor location; Keep the cloth/taps/vanity relationship usable without duplicate tub parts. Read the original edit scope. Existing background defects are not new edit defects. Exact dimensions and light controls remain automatic.

anchors.0: Absent, wholly wrong, or no visible evidence of the required result; no credit.
anchors.1: Weak resemblance/fulfilment (about one quarter); major omissions or pervasive defects.
anchors.2: Partial (about half); recognizable intent but material errors in key requirements or visual quality.
anchors.3: Mostly correct (about three quarters); concrete remaining discrepancies prevent excellent credit.
anchors.4: Excellent: all important visible requirements satisfied, coherent and polished, no material discrepancy. Requires explicit positive evidence, not merely lack of reported faults.
